_readme: Fresh-install add-on seed for Scenix. The hub reads this file only when data/addons.json
does not exist yet; it never rewrites an owner's installed list from here.
The external entries are catalogues, subtitle search and watch-link services. The native
entries are code that already ships in providers/: Local Files reads the owner's own media
folder, Public Domain Movies is the bundled legal shelf, Live TV needs the owner's playlist,
and Kids YouTube reads its curated channel allow-list. No torrent index, paid account,
credential or personal data belongs in this list.
This is also a valid data/addons.json if an owner deliberately wants to pin it, but the
normal path is to leave data/addons.json alone and edit this file only when changing what a
brand-new hub starts with. An existing hub keeps its own list, including any source it added.
fields: id (stable, shown in Settings), name, url (external only), native (true for a file in
providers/), enabled, priority (external order, lower is asked first)
